title: Exact native flow, opened and codec-closed stream clauses

result.scope: Production native audio only; actual duplex before ready/open, exact opened shape and immutable codec-close shape. Handle allocation timing and full immediate-replacement semantics are separate.

assertions: An admitted signed offer and answer produce no readiness/opened event before actual media; an authenticated reliable heartbeat returns only its ACK.

Actual independent decoded audio is exchanged in both directions. Each physical Connection then emits one connection.ready before its stream.opened; unrelated operation collectors preserve pending events.
Revoking the actual target Endpoint prevents fresh lifecycle events after revocation while the other physical source continues its own authorized quality interval.

Six actual signed stream.opened payloads include their exact original logical Stream ID, kind audio, selected codec with params/sample_rate8000/channels1, direction sendrecv, physical-peer uint16 handle and RFC3339 opened_at no later than the server envelope timestamp.

The public SDK verifies current enrolled server signatures before collecting the observations. Existing tests independently compare each Stream/Connection/physical handle to the actual negotiated media binding.
Observed replacement metadata names PCMA and its new physical handle only after actual replacement duplex flow.
The actual signed stream.closed payload retains the original Stream ID, RFC3339 closed_at and numeric reason_code200 with reason codec-renegotiated under the exact original CID/SID/Connection.
The replacement code path first closes the original binding and opens only its actually observed PCMA replacement; unrelated audio remains live.

profile: Actual production Connect native QUIC listener/public signed SDK, ordinary public Conversation/Session creation and invitation/acceptance, actual media endpoint/resource negotiation, independent decoded audio and fresh current Store lifecycle delivery policy. These are existing implementation cases rerun and reconciled to exact clauses.
limits: 22 of61 assigned clauses now locally qualified;39 remain. Full G6-046 and the105-task goal remain incomplete.

This report qualifies the recorded native audio shapes and flow. Video/screenshare/data event profiles and other closure reason paths are not newly qualified. Stream-close signing here is EdDSA; opened/flow are EdDSA and ES256.
Clause0109 handle-allocation timing remains open. The observed handle values are verified, but this does not prove when allocation occurs.

Clause0111 immediate replacement remains open: actual codec closed-to-replacement-open gap was1395.008ms while the test established fresh replacement duplex. Ordered replacement alone does not prove the immediate boundary.
No Linux, production remote/browser/provider, named G6-093 qualification, acceptance or publication.
reproduce: Set CONNECT_NATIVE_LIFECYCLE_OBSERVATIONS to an absolute ignored .local/gate-6 JSONL file; run the two exact production lifecycle tests using CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p connect-server --test gate6_canonical_runtime --locked --offline -j1 <test-name> -- --exact --test-threads=1.
